name: Repo::snapshot_before_edit_and_undo

test_list.description: Snapshots restore exact bytes and executable state.
Undo conflicts before mutation when a target diverged and leaves user edits intact.
Undo consumes one sealed action and the next undo reaches the previous action.
Durable journal and CAS state remain available to a reopened Repo.
A crash after target quarantine is recovered without overwriting intervening changes.
Missing snapshots fail without partially replacing user files.

output_description: Dry-run and guarded restoration driven by durable CAS-backed action records.
